scripts-descriptions.test: Run the four phpunit testsuites as separate processes, the same shape CI uses. A single-process aggregate run (bare vendor/bin/phpunit) lets constants like DOING_CRON defined by one suite leak into another and silently bypass capability-denial tests. Requires WP_TESTS_DIR in the environment.
